{{Quote|Wielders of the magical "spellswords".|Description}}
'''Gladiator''' is a [[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance jobs|job]] from ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' for [[bangaa]] who can become Gladiators after mastering two [[Warrior (Tactics Advance)|Warrior]] abilities. Gladiators wield the powerful blades and can learn three "Spell Blades" to deal damage and some [[Fighter (Tactics Advance)|Fighter]] abilities. When raised right, Gladiators are very powerful and, when equipped with Strikeback, it is difficult to get in a hit.

==Growth==
Gladiators are basically the same as [[Dragoon (Tactics Advance)|Dragoons]], although with higher MP, lower Attack, higher Defense, and slightly higher Magic Power.

== Overview ==
Gladiators are similar to [[Fighter (Tactics Advance)|Fighters]] in that they have identical stat growths and share several abilities. Gladiators have high attack, HP, and defense, with low magic power and resistance. The Spellblade abilities provide a decent selection of elemental damage, and their Ultima Sword is the Ultima ability for the [[bangaa]]. However, Gladiators have many shortcomings. Their ability set is lacking, having no ranged attacks. They are often compared negatively towards a similar offensive class, the [[Dragoon (Tactics Advance)|Dragoon]]. They have slightly higher MP than usual, but few ways to use their MP supply. Silence can affect Gladiators more than most other bangaa, as it takes away a few of their abilities. Overall, Gladiators are a somewhat unusual offensive class that generally pales in comparison to the Dragoon, but they can still hold up on their own.

Most physical walls can go up against enemy Gladiators without much worry, since they have no supporting abilities. Ranged units and mages can toast Gladiators while keeping their distance.
